text:
alex: quick heads-up — running long-context loadtest (32k tokens) on h100 shows steady kvcache growth over time, leading to OOM after ~3h. logs/heapmap attached.

sam: can you paste the repro command?

alex: yes: `./run_inference --model pagedattn-48b --context 32768 --batch 8 --device h100`
Profiler snapshot: `kvcache.pages=34.2M, pagetable.entries=2.1M, evict_rate=0.7/s`
Partial allocation map: `holes: [0x1200-0x1400, 0x1500-0x1510, 0x1700-0x2000]`
This looks like a failure to coalesce small freed ranges; fragmentation grows with repeated prefix caching.

jin: interesting. do you see different behavior on a100? any hw-diff?

alex: a100 run didn't blow up, fragmentation stayed bounded. suspected because our allocator hits 64k coalesce threshold; h100 workload produces many 8k fragments so coalescing never triggers.
Here's a perf excerpt from `perf trace kvcache_coalesce`: `calls=1.2M, avg_span=7.9k, coalesce_hits=0.04%`

maria: could be the recent commit that changed free-list bin sizes. @rachel any bisect candidate?

rachel: started bisect — candidate range 0cf3..2a9b changed slab split logic on 2025-10-12. I'll run quick repro on CI.

alex: workaround that helped locally: set `RT_KVCACHE_COALESCE_THRESHOLD=4096` and `kvcache_aggressive_coalesce=1` — reduced pagetable entries 3x and eliminated OOM for 6h run. Not ideal perf-wise but good for stability.

sam: capture: can you add counters for `coalesce_attempts` + `merged_bytes` and a flame graph of `kvcache_free`? we need to see kernel hotpaths.

alex: done — results uploaded to /mnt/telemetry/1799123456/coalesce-report.html. Key note: `kvcache_free` spends 28% cpu searching buddy bins on h100; on a100 it's <4%.

jin: suggests short-term: lower threshold to 4k on h100 builds and add metric alert `pt_entries_growth > 1.5x in 1h`
Long-term: rework slab bins to avoid microfragments or add on-the-fly compaction during low-load windows.

maria: agreed. created ticket INF-7893 to prototype compaction and add new metrics. also added `kvcache_coalesce=debug` log level for nightly runs.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: canary to h100 pool at 2025-11-03T03:00Z with `kvcache_coalesce_threshold=4096` (owner: rachel)

rachel: I'll run bisect + CI smoke and report back tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
